gloss: the greatest person in the land; thirteen orphans (mahjong)

definitions.gloss: the greatest person in the land; a peerless talent
definitions.explanation: A person of unequaled ability in the whole country. From a classical Chinese description of the general Han Xin; a literary, old-fashioned phrase.
In mahjong, a rare winning hand made of one each of the thirteen terminal and honor tiles plus a pair of any one of them. Today this is the sense most Japanese know.

notes:
Made of {国士|こくし} (an outstanding person of the nation) + ⟦{無双|むそう}→無双：32138_musou⟧ (without equal).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {国士無双|こくしむそう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{上|あ}がる→上がる：00615_agaru⟧: to win with thirteen orphans (sense 2)
- {国士無双|こくしむそう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{英雄|えいゆう}→英雄：14117_eiyuu⟧: a peerless hero (sense 1)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{天下無双|てんかむそう}→天下無双：32708_tenkamusou⟧: unrivaled in the world (of strength or skill, the commoner phrase for sense 1)
- {役満|やくまん}: a limit hand in mahjong, the class that includes {国士無双|こくしむそう}
